title: Storey Architecture contact
description: A huge five-line invitation at the left, partly covered by a large off-white paper form pinned with a paperclip: a mono 'brief' title and the wordmark at the top, numbered fields drawn as single underlines, a two-by-two row of square checkboxes, a three-line message area, a grey Submit button and a mono footer row under a hairline. A short paragraph sits under the heading. On desktop the paper drifts down slowly as you scroll.
notes: the form posts to `action` with ordinary field names; no JavaScript needed
the paper uses --card and --card-foreground; Submit is the secondary (form grey) button
on phones the paragraph moves under the form (the original hides it behind the paper)
